concept.title: How to set up a print server
concept.shortdesc: The objective of a print server is to streamline and optimize printing tasks throughout the network. The print server works as an intermediary between client computers and printers, handling print jobs and ensuring efficient print management.

ul.li: Ensure you have administrative rights on the server.
Ensure SNMP is enabled on the network.

section.title: Steps to set up a print server

ol.li: Log in to the Windows Server with administrative credentials.
Open the 'Server Manager' from the Start menu.
In the 'Server Manager' dashboard, click on 'Add roles and features'.
Follow the wizard and select 'Print and Document Services'.
Choose 'Print Server' and proceed with the installation.
Once installed, open 'Print Management' from the Tools menu.

For Windows Server 2019:
Right-click on 'Print Servers' and select 'Add/Remove Servers'.
Add the local server and configure the print queues as needed.

For Windows Server 2022:
Navigate to 'Print Servers' and select 'Manage'.
Configure the print queues and printer drivers as required.
